english.note: This is the colloquial all-purpose term for a woman whose main role is looking after the home.

exampleSentences.english: The housewife does not have to go to work and looks after the children and cooks every day.
exampleSentences.traditional: 住家婆唔使返工，日日湊仔煮飯。
